summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the Onboarding Tour and Monthly Cash Export features. 7/7 pytest cases pass; all UI flows (auto-open on first login, step navigation, back disabled on step 1, finish button on step 3, persistence to /auth/me, header reopen via tour-open-button, Escape close, no auto-open after reload, mobile bottom-sheet layout at 390px, monthly CSV download, daily CSV download, no regression on start-consultation-btn) pass. Demo doctor tour has been reset to false at end so the user can see the tour at next login.
critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingTour.jsx uses requestAnimationFrame in a continuous loop (tick calls requestAnimationFrame recursively) to re-measure the spotlight rect while open. This keeps the main thread busy at 60fps for the entire duration of the tour. Consider only re-measuring on scroll/resize or using a ResizeObserver + MutationObserver combo instead of a rAF loop.
In Dashboard.jsx effect deps use `user?.tour_done` with eslint-disable; could use a ref or memo to avoid the disable comment.
CashRegister: new Date(y, m, 0).getDate() correctly returns last day of month `m` due to 0-based day; good. Note the daily and monthly inputs are both capped at today's month – acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None. Reset tour_completed_at=null for the demo doctor at the end of testing as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding tour and monthly cash export are fully working. Demo doctor currently has tour_done=false. Backend endpoints: POST /api/onboarding/tour {completed:bool}; GET /api/payments/export?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD returns CSV. Frontend data-testids: onboarding-tour, tour-step-{1..3}, tour-spotlight, tour-progress, tour-next-btn, tour-back-btn, tour-skip-btn, tour-finish-btn, tour-open-button, tour-body, cash-monthly, cash-month-input, cash-export-month-btn, cash-export-btn.
